name: USS Missouri (BB-63)
description: A battleship belonging to the U.S. Navy, it is the third U.S. warship named after the state of Missouri. It is also the last battleship built by the U.S. Navy and the last battleship decommissioned during World War II. Construction began at the Brooklyn Shipyard in 1941. It is an Iowa-class battleship with a length of 270 meters, a width of 32.9 meters, and a speed of up to 33 knots. It entered service in 1944. It won three and five battle stars in World War II and the Korean War respectively. It is famous for being assigned as a surrender ship at the end of World War II. After the war, it was used as a museum ship for tourists around the world to visit.
